title: AI Revolution in Railways: Modernizing Travel for a Smarter Future
description: Artificial intelligence modernizes railways with predictive maintenance, autonomous trains, and optimized scheduling, enhancing safety.
short_description: A no-hype introduction to AI in railways, built around real applications, limits, and better judgement.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: A practical overview of AI in railways for operators, planners, analysts, product teams, and readers tracking mobility systems.
